headline: Saudi Arabia: Important oil pipeline shut down after attack
summary: Saudi Arabia has shut down the strategically important pipeline between its eastern oil fields and the port city of Yanbu after a drone attack. The pipeline is a key route for bypassing the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The East-West pipeline lets Saudi Arabia export crude from the Red Sea coast when Gulf shipping is constrained, so its closure reduces a major alternative export route.
